name: @airship/api
description: Go HTTP API. Its OpenAPI document is the source of truth for @airship/client.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:cacheproxy && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/ ./cmd/api ./cmd/migrate ./cmd/openapi
scripts.build:cacheproxy: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o internal/assets/bin/cacheproxy-linux-amd64 ./cmd/cacheproxy && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o internal/assets/bin/cacheproxy-linux-arm64 ./cmd/cacheproxy
scripts.generate: go tool -modfile=tools/go.mod sqlc generate && go run ./cmd/openapi -o openapi.json
